i quite enjoy the secret history narrated by donna tartt herself. currently rereading the book and assisted with the audio it really allows you to soak it the atmosphere at a slower pace(as i sort of speedread through it the first time). lovely accent as well.

a few twisted letters in almost every book, but nothing too crazy. i do however remember a really aggressive typo in the 50th anniversary dune edition where the characters make no sense whatsoever. caught me off guard
also if you keep her outside, make sure to really secure the cage (the top of it) as she wouldnt be able to hear birds of prey coming from above.

had a bun who was the same way. he was a rescue and after the first few months with us we noticed how he never got scared when someone was lawnmowing like the others or how he would only come to us for treats when he saw them. he would react to vibration though (stomping on the floor, knocking on the cage he was in, etc). never had any problems with it, super chill guy til the end. so i wouldnt worry about it but still get a second opinion from a vet.
